name: Recoverability Confidence Bounds
purpose: Define confidence bounds for trace-recoverability while blocking claims of full source reconstruction.

confidence_bounds.name: none
confidence_bounds.definition: No confidence in recoverability; trace is broken or missing.

confidence_bounds.name: trace_pointer_only
confidence_bounds.definition: Confidence in basic source-relation linkage, but no context is recoverable.

confidence_bounds.name: partial_context
confidence_bounds.definition: Confidence in recovering some aspect roles and loss categories.

confidence_bounds.name: reentry_ready_reference
confidence_bounds.definition: High confidence in trace-metadata completeness for re-entering whole-relation analysis.

governance_rules.rule: Projected forms cannot reconstruct ⇔R by themselves, regardless of confidence bound.
Confidence bounds apply to trace metadata quality, not source-relation truth.

forbidden_claims: Trace confidence replaces loss accounting requirements.
